import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int MAX_N = 12;
    static final int MAX_T = 62;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 210;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 21000;

    static class Edge {
        int v, w;
        Edge(int v, int w) { this.v = v; this.w = w; }
    }

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] adj = new int[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int edge_count = 0;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges[edge_count] = new Edge(v, w);
        adj[edge_count] = head[u];
        head[u] = edge_count++;

        edges[edge_count] = new Edge(u, 0);
        adj[edge_count] = head[v];
        head[v] = edge_count++;
    }

    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] queue_arr = new int[MAX_NODES * 2];
    static int[] arc = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] gap = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] inq = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] pre = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static int SAP(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(arc, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        int qf = 0, qr = 0;
        queue_arr[qr++] = t;
        inq[t] = 1;
        gap[0]++;
        dist[t] = 0;

        while (qf < qr) {
            int u = queue_arr[qf++];
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                int v = edges[i].v;
                if (inq[v] == 0) {
                    queue_arr[qr++] = v;
                    inq[v] = 1;
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    gap[dist[v]]++;
                    arc[v] = head[v];
                }
            }
        }

        int low = INF, u = s, ans = 0;
        pre[s] = s;

        while (dist[s] < t) {
            boolean found = false;
            for (int i = arc[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                if (edges[i].w > 0 && dist[edges[i].v] + 1 == dist[u]) {
                    found = true;
                    low = Math.min(low, edges[i].w);
                    pre[edges[i].v] = u;
                    u = edges[i].v;
                    if (u == t) {
                        while (u != s) {
                            u = pre[u];
                            edges[arc[u]].w -= low;
                            edges[arc[u] ^ 1].w += low;
                        }
                        ans += low;
                        low = INF;
                    }
                    break;
                }
                arc[u] = adj[i];
            }

            if (found) continue;

            int min_dist = t + 1;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                if (edges[i].w > 0 && min_dist > dist[edges[i].v]) {
                    min_dist = dist[edges[i].v];
                    arc[u] = i;
                }
            }

            gap[dist[u]]--;
            if (gap[dist[u]] == 0) return ans;
            dist[u] = min_dist + 1;
            gap[dist[u]]++;
            u = pre[u];
        }

        return ans;
    }

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] sci = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] ca = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][][] stone = new int[MAX_T][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[MAX_T][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] dirs = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int n, t;

    static void expandStone() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= t; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (stone[k-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        stone[k][i][j] = 1;
                    } else if (stone[k-1][i][j] == 2) {
                        stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                    } else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = i + dirs[d][0], nj = j + dirs[d][1];
                            if (ni >= 1 && ni <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n) {
                                if (stone[k-1][ni][nj] == 2) {
                                    stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[MAX_N][MAX_N];

    static void dfs(int sx, int sy, int cx, int cy, int k) {
        visited[cx][cy] = true;
        dp[k][sx][sy][cx][cy] = 1;

        if (k >= t || stone[k][cx][cy] != 0) return;

        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nx = cx + dirs[d][0], ny = cy + dirs[d][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && !visited[nx][ny]) {
                if (stone[k][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                dfs(sx, sy, nx, ny, k+1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int dummy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 100000; ++i) dummy++;

        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') stone[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y') stone[0][i][j] = 1;
                else sci[i][j] = grid1[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(line.charAt(j-1))) {
                    ca[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        expandStone();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAX_N; ++x) Arrays.fill(visited[x], false);
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int k = 1; k <= t; ++k) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                            dp[k][x][y][nx][ny] += dp[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int S = 0, T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edge_count = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                addEdge(S, (i-1)*n + j, sci[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                addEdge(n*n + (i-1)*n + j, T, ca[i][j]);
            }
        }

        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && ca[nx][ny] != 0) {
                            if (dp[t][x][y][nx][ny] != 0) {
                                addEdge((x-1)*n + y, n*n + (nx-1)*n + ny, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int result = SAP(S, T);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
